findings.text: non-blocking: the settlement covers only the review-missing kind, while a review-queued row (reckon/crew/obligations.py:205, set at :2365 from the pointer's review_dispatch refusal and its bound) carries the same pointer-borne evidence, so a held answer can still list a queued review for a run whose pointer has gone and whose review nothing can now launch.

non-blocking: _same_revision duplicates same_revision at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:105 rather than extending its owner; the module's load-by-path constraint argues for the copy, but unlike the PRODUCER_POLL_INTERVAL_CAP_SECONDS mirror at :76 no test pins the two to agreement.

non-blocking: _review_dispatch_for_head accepts a dispatch entry whose recorded head is absent as covering any head the duty names, which is the permissive direction; a pointer whose dispatch record lost its head settles a duty that may in fact still be owed.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against a4717d952f: 3b1ed7f426 adds the settlement and its helpers, 35a31e3b8a adds the test file and restates the superseded assertion, 69e234d535 adds the evidence fragment; five files, 509 insertions and 23 deletions.

justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:1227 settles the review-missing row on the pointer's absence and on a dispatched review for the named head, as the goal and the section's Done when state, but the review-queued kind at reckon/crew/obligations.py:205 carries the same pointer-borne evidence and is left unsettled.
